'''''Cynanchum acutum''''' is a species of climbing vine swallowworts native to Europe, Africa, and Asia.<ref name=GRIN>{{GRIN | accessdate = 23 January 2018}}</ref><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=210000419 Flora of China Vol. 16 Page 210 <big>戟叶鹅绒藤</big> ji ye e rong teng ''Cynanchum acutum'' subsp. sibiricum (Willdenow) K. H. Rechinger, Fl. Iranica. 73: 9. 1970.]</ref>

==Taxonomy==
Two subspecies are often distinguished:
* ''Cynanchum acutum'' subsp. ''acutum'', Europe, Africa, western Asia<ref name=GRIN/>
* ''Cynanchum acutum'' subsp. ''sibiricum'', Asian<ref>{{citation |mode=cs1 |chapter-url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=210000419 |author=Bingtao Li |author2=Michael G. Gilbert |author3=W. Douglas Stevens |title=Flora of China |editor=Wu, C. Y. |editor2=P. H. Raven |volume=16 |chapter=''Cynanchum acutum'' subsp. ''sibiricum'' (Willdenow) K. H. Rechinger}}</ref>
